explicit_human_request.description: Customer explicitly requests a human before any investigation.
explicit_human_request.customer_message: I don't want to troubleshoot this anymore. Please transfer me to a human agent now.
explicit_human_request.case_context: The issue concerns a standard order-status question. No investigation has been performed yet.

frustrated_simple_issue.description: Customer is frustrated, but the request is within policy and the customer has not requested a human.
frustrated_simple_issue.customer_message: This is ridiculous. I bought this from your own site 5 days ago for $120, and the current site price is $100. Fix it.
frustrated_simple_issue.case_context: Policy: Own-site price adjustments are permitted within 14 days when purchase evidence is available. The purchase is verified and was made 5 days ago. No competitor price match is requested.
frustrated_simple_issue.expected_decision: Acknowledge frustration and offer the permitted adjustment. Do not escalate solely due to sentiment.

reiterated_human_request.description: Agent has offered a policy-supported resolution, but the customer then explicitly requests a human.
reiterated_human_request.customer_message: I understand the adjustment is possible, but I still want to speak with a human agent.
reiterated_human_request.case_context: The previous assistant offered a policy-supported own-site price adjustment. No human handoff has occurred.
reiterated_human_request.expected_decision: Honor the renewed request and escalate without arguing or continuing the attempted resolution.

competitor_price_gap.description: The policy does not address competitor price matching.
competitor_price_gap.customer_message: A competitor sells this for $90. Match their price for me.
competitor_price_gap.case_context: Policy: Own-site price adjustments are permitted within 14 days when purchase evidence is available. The policy contains no rule for matching competitor prices.
competitor_price_gap.expected_decision: Do not promise a match. Escalate for a policy decision because the policy is silent on competitor matching.

multiple_customer_matches.description: The customer lookup returns multiple plausible matches.
multiple_customer_matches.case_context: Customer lookup result: three records match the name Alex Sharma. No order number, email address, or postcode was provided.
multiple_customer_matches.expected_decision: Ask for an additional identifier. Do not choose a record or cancel an order yet.

cannot_make_progress.description: The agent cannot determine a safe or authorized next step after checking available information.
cannot_make_progress.customer_message: Please make an exception and refund this charge. The reason doesn't fit any of the listed refund policies.
cannot_make_progress.case_context: Available policy does not cover this reason for a refund. No authorized exception procedure or approval is available in the supplied context.
cannot_make_progress.expected_decision: Explain the policy gap and escalate because meaningful progress requires a human policy decision.

sentiment_is_not_complexity.description: Compare a frustrated straightforward request with a calm explicit human request.
sentiment_is_not_complexity.customer_message: I'm calm, but I want a human agent to handle this case.
sentiment_is_not_complexity.case_context: The customer explicitly requests a human. Case details have not been investigated.
sentiment_is_not_complexity.expected_decision: Escalate immediately because the customer requested a human, regardless of sentiment or perceived complexity.
